title: apiGuard
text: Public API: set package’s exported functions together formal arguments, argument order, default values. Nothing else compared — internal helpers outside API definition. Avoid: interface, surface, exports Snapshot: Public API one version one package, captured statically parsing sources. Snapshot fact version, never change. Avoid: scan, dump, state Diff: comparison two Snapshots, expressed ordered set Change Records. Avoid: delta, comparison, report Change Record: One difference two Snapshots, carrying kind, function belongs , human-readable detail, exactly one Severity. Avoid: finding, issue, violation Severity: consequence Change Record existing calling code. Exactly three values exist — Breaking, Feature, Behaviour — every Change Record one. Avoid: level, priority, class Breaking: Existing calling code stops working silently changes meaning. Covers loud failures (removed function, new required argument) silent ones (positional argument shifting different meaning). Breaking; silent case one tool exists catch. Avoid: major, incompatible Feature: New capability existing call can observe. existing calls keep working keep meaning thing. Avoid: minor, addition, enhancement Behaviour: Every existing call still runs still resolves arguments, value default supplies changed, result may differ. Distinct Breaking caller’s code still correct; distinct Feature caller’s results may move . Avoid: behavioural, semantic change, soft break Bump: SemVer step Diff recommends: major, minor, patch. Derived Severities present Diff, never asserted directly. Avoid: increment, version change Gate: CI check turns Diff build outcome. Gate consumes Severities Bump must never block release Bump recommends. Avoid: guard, barrier, check

title: Detect Breaking API Changes Between R Package Versions
text: R revdepcheck (runs reverse dependencies — powerful slow, runtime-based) pkgdiff (compares CRAN versions). apiGuard fills gap release: Static: parses sources, install, dependency resolution Git-native: compare working tree vs. last release tag Actionable: SemVer bump suggestion + ready--paste NEWS.md section CI-ready: one-liner gate fails build breaking changes

title: Detect Breaking API Changes Between R Package Versions
code: library(apiGuard)  # Compare working tree against last release tag diff <- compare_api(api_snapshot_ref("v1.0.0"), api_snapshot(".")) diff  # SemVer recommendation suggest_version_bump(diff, current_version = "1.0.0") #> Suggested bump: major -> 2.0.0  # NEWS.md section cat(generate_news_section(diff, version = "2.0.0"))

title: Detect Breaking API Changes Between R Package Versions
text: Fails build breaking changes. Behaviour-level changes (changed default) recommend minor bump fail gate — pass strict = TRUE check_api() treat breaking . default deliberately matches suggest_version_bump(), gate never blocks bump tool recommends (see docs/adr/0001-behaviour-change-policy.md).
code: - name: API breaking-change check   run: |     Rscript -e 'apiGuard::check_api(apiGuard::api_snapshot_ref("v1.0.0"), ".")'   shell: bash
